pages.title: Black Worker of Filth
pages.text: Place a carved pumpkin on a maggot block to summon a fly.$(br2)Flies are the basic resource for breeding chests and fly barrels.

pages.title: Special Variants
pages.text: Drowning a fly drops a blue fly; killing it with a roundworm drops a white fly; cactus drops a green fly; a poop ball drops a brown fly; lightning drops a black fly.$(br2)Feeding a fly chili gives a red fly, while feeding it King of Dragon Fruit gives a dragon fruit fly.
